notes.title: [Part 1 of the Final 4 Updates] 0.2.4 Release– Milana’s Visna Crystal Party
notes.notes:
First of all, thanks for waiting! (I was on vacation for ten days, and during that time, I made 28 CGs—14 large ones and 14 smaller ones.)



Added new locations and new quests. Previous saves are no longer compatible, so please refer to the bolded sections to play the new update.
If you encounter an error when loading a save, please use my save file from this link: Save File (It’s the second one on page 9). Use it to play the latest Visna Crystal Party scene. Just place the save files into the game/saves folder in the root directory of the game.Alternatively, you can quickly replay Chapter 11 and complete all previous tasks. Milana will send you a text message once it's done. Sorry for the trouble, I tested it myself today—it takes about 5 minutes to speed through.

notes.notes:
Please use my save file to maximize a smooth gaming experience. The save file is at the end of the article. Please use it.


Sorry for the long wait. 
This time, it’s really because my daily 9-5 job has been too busy, which delayed things a bit and led to some content being cut. 
However, I firmly believe that this update will still satisfy my players and fans.

 After updating, please don’t load your old save files.


 Either replay Chapter 11 from scratch or use the save files, which are at the bottom of this log.
